comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: As a video editor, I have to praise the narrative structure of this documentary! Starting with that epic World Cup match against Argentina [00:26] to hook the audience, and then revealing that their true strength comes from the resilient "Rabidantes" women [09:52] and their deep cultural roots. The quote "They turned music into their identity" [26:58] perfectly summarizes how Morna isn't just music, but the literal heartbeat of the island. Brilliant storytelling! 🇨🇻👏
